w10_T4_000307: Mia walks 121 yards to the bus stop every day, 7 days a week, and checks her pedometer twice a day. She keeps her weekly total in feet, since there are 3 feet in a yard. This week she walked an extra 36 feet to a mailbox and 63 feet around a puddle. Her brother Noah walked fewer feet than Mia this week. How many feet did Mia walk this week?
w10_T4_000309: Rafael had 167 nickels and spent 28 of them. He counted the rest in cents, at 5 cents to a nickel, and saved that same amount every week for 6 weeks. He then split his savings equally among 5 jars. Each jar is 15 centimetres tall. He added 42 cents to the first jar. How many cents are in the first jar?
w10_T4_000314: The cinema sold 217 tickets in advance and 58 at the door, each for 9 dollars. A sponsor matched the takings, doubling the amount. Half of that went to the film distributor, and the rest became the cinema's fund. Concession sales added 42 dollars to the fund, and 859 dollars of wages were paid out of it. How many dollars are in the fund?
w10_T4_000315: A parking meter collects 126 nickels every day. The council records the total in cents, and a nickel is 5 cents. The meter ran for 7 days. The collector also found 18 cents on the ground and 33 cents wedged in the slot. How many cents did the collector record?
w10_T4_000317: The camp had 93 campers, and 21 more arrived late. They were split equally into 6 cabins. Every camper in the first cabin was given 9 tokens for the camp store, and the cabin pooled them. The cabin spent 66 tokens on a canoe trip, and the rest was shared equally among its 3 counsellors. How many tokens does the head counsellor get?
w10_T4_000323: Dev found 15 nickels in a drawer and 35 more in the car. He spent 39 nickels on a comic. He wrote the rest into his cents ledger, at 5 cents to a nickel. Then he took 16 cents out of the ledger for a stamp and a dozen cents for a gumball. How many cents are in Dev's ledger?
w10_T4_000325: In the morning Grace picked 71 apples in the orchard, a dozen miles from town, then 13 more and another 21. In the afternoon she threw out 9 rotten ones and picked 61 more. In the evening a buyer paid 3 coins for each apple and added a 50 coin tip. How many coins did Grace receive?
w10_T4_000328: In the morning Hiro's team packed 142 cartons with 8 jars in each, and half of the jars were sold at the early market. In the afternoon the remaining jars were split equally among 4 shops, and the first shop calls its share the shelf stock. In the evening the first shop received 63 more jars for its shelf stock. Hiro's rival Sato sold fewer jars than Hiro. How many jars are in the first shop's shelf stock?
w10_T4_000329: A landscaper bought 173 yards of hose and measured it in feet, at 3 feet to a yard. Every foot of hose needs 6 clips. He used half of the clips on the first day and put the rest in a spare box. Then 182 clips were lost from the spare box. How many clips are in the spare box?
w10_T4_000331: A warehouse had 189 cartons of syrup. It shipped 169 cartons and threw out 18 damaged ones. Each remaining carton holds 3 boxes, and each box holds 2 gallons. The syrup is sold by the pint, and there are 8 pints in a gallon. Each pint sells for 6 dollars. How many dollars will the syrup bring in?
w10_T4_000335: Wei's stall had 206 bags of rice, each weighing 5 kilograms, which he weighed twice to be sure. He sold all of it at 9 yuan per kilogram. He paid his supplier 7605 yuan and received a 72 yuan tip. His cousin Ling's stall earned less than Wei's. How many yuan does Wei have?
w10_T4_000336: Tara started a game with 53 gems and collected 20 more on the first of a dozen levels. She spent 25 gems on a key and found 80 in a cave. A troll took 9 gems and she dropped 6 in a river. Every gem is worth 9 points at the end. How many points does Tara score?
w10_T4_000337: In the morning 5 machines at the mill each ran for 192 minutes, but 601 of those minutes were idle and struck off the bill. In the afternoon the machines ran for 74 billable minutes. In the evening they ran for one more hour, which is 60 minutes. How many billable minutes did the mill record?
w10_T4_000352: At the party 40 cupcakes were shared equally among 5 children. The party started at 3 o'clock. Emma ate 7 of her cupcakes. She cut what was left into 4 pieces, then cut each piece into 2, and then cut each of those into 2 again. Her brother Jack has more cupcakes left than Emma. How many pieces does Emma have?
w10_T4_000354: Leon kept 200 beehives. He lost 24 hives over the winter and gained 3 new swarms. His neighbour Ada has fewer hives than Leon. Each hive has 6 frames, and each frame yields 6 jars of honey. He also has 26 jars left from last year. How many jars of honey does Leon have?
w10_T4_000356: A tailor had 97 feet of linen, and 10 feet were water-damaged. She measured the rest in yards, at 3 feet to a yard, and used 11 yards for a dress. The linen costs 12 dollars a yard. She split the remainder into 3 equal bolts, then took 4 yards from the first bolt for a scarf. Each yard left on that bolt makes 7 napkins. How many napkins can she make from the first bolt?
w10_T4_000361: A renovation was planned for 29 weeks. After 26 weeks the crew stopped, and 1 week of the plan was cancelled. The foreman wrote the remaining time in days, at 7 days to a week. Each day needs 6 hours of labour. How many hours of labour remain?
w10_T4_000366: In the morning the bakery had 84 pies and baked 12 more, then sold 31. In the afternoon each remaining pie was cut into 4 slices. In the evening every slice sold for 5 dollars. How many dollars did the slices bring in?
w10_T4_000373: In the morning the vineyard counted 150 bearing vines, then found 20 more in the lower field and 8 along the fence. In the afternoon each vine gave 5 bunches, and each bunch weighed 8 ounces. In the evening 4704 ounces were pressed for juice. How many ounces of grapes remain?
w10_T4_000379: Ines was granted 17 weeks of leave, which HR wrote into her leave bank in days, at 7 days to a week. Then 72 days were carried over from last year. She used 48 days in spring and 90 days in summer. In autumn 68 days were granted for a course. How many days are in Ines's leave bank?
w10_T4_000382: The juice bar had 47 pints of orange juice, sold 28 pints, and took a delivery of 65 pints. The bar has 6 stools. It serves juice in cups, at 2 cups to a pint. Every cup sells for 5 dollars. How many dollars will the juice sell for?
w10_T4_000384: Tessa and Ruby split 236 raffle tickets, and Tessa took half. Tessa then bought 61 more tickets, so she had more than Ruby. The draw is at 8 o'clock. Each ticket earns 5 points, and Tessa spent 579 points on a prize. How many points does Tessa have left?
w10_T4_000386: In the morning the tip jar held 65 cents; the barista counts it in cents and never converts to dollars, checking it twice a shift. He took 29 cents for a coffee, and a customer added 61 cents. In the afternoon 85 cents went for a bus fare and 2 cents were dropped down a drain. In the evening a regular left 79 cents. How many cents are in the jar?
w10_T4_000392: The farm had 99 gallons of milk, recorded in quarts because there are 4 quarts in a gallon. The farm keeps 14 cows. It sold 75 quarts, lost 52 quarts to spoilage, and received 69 quarts from a neighbour. Each quart sells for 6 dollars, and the farm paid 1050 dollars for feed. How many dollars does the farm have left?
w10_T4_000403: Malik had 71 cards, won 46 in a tournament, and was given 61 by his uncle. A shop promotion doubled his collection, and a second promotion doubled it again. He gave 633 cards to Jade, who then had more cards than Malik. He then lost 36 cards on the bus. How many cards does Malik have?
